connector.name: Lumify Sports Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Schedules, scores, odds, splits & explainable AI bet confidence - 8+ sports, free instant key.
connector.summary: Hosted at lumify.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.lumify, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Lumify API key as a Bearer token ('Bearer lmfy-...'). Get one free in seconds with no signup at https://lumify.ai/docs/ai, or create an account key at https://lumify.ai/api-keys. The server never stores your key.
